noah: publish blocked by release-gate after a regen in CI. I didn't change code, just ran typegen. Gate flagged semver risk due to parameter order.
anya: can you paste a tiny diff?
noah: ```diff
- func AttachKey(ctx context.Context, keyID string, opts AttachOpts) error
+ func AttachKey(ctx context.Context, opts AttachOpts, keyID string) error
```
marc: that's the nondeterministic ordering issue — generator fell back to map iteration for params when metadata missing.
regen-bot: regen-report: files: sdk/go/keys.gen.go, potential-semver: parameter-order, release-gate: BLOCKED
ci-bot: typegen-check exited 3: regen diff non-empty.
anya: short term: run `make typegen-stable` in the CI image and commit. long term: enforce deterministic keys in typegen and update changelog logic to ignore pure reorders.
noah: did local stable regen: "INFO: stable sort complete, diff empty". pushed and retriggered pipeline.
ci-bot: re-run: typegen-check PASS. release-gate PASS.
marc: I'll open a PR to add a deterministic sort and a unit test that simulates missing locale/author metadata. Also will tweak changelog heuristics so reorder-only doesn't cause semver bumps.
anya: also file a follow-up to check go-sdk auth/retry parity tests; they flaked last week and might be related to nondet header ordering.
noah: thanks — publish proceeded. Closing thread. :tada:
